title: test_requirements
description: Schema for the test_requirements block produced by business-analyst and embedded in ticket bodies. Used by test-writer to author tests and by check_test_requirements_refs.py to verify schema version consistency across all consumers. Version 1.1.0 adds live_dispatch type and surface_invoked field.

rationale.description: One-sentence explanation of why tests are needed, or why the tests array is empty.

tests.description: Ordered list of test specifications. May be empty for docs-only or config-only tickets.

name.description: Test file or function name. Must start with 'test_' per naming_pattern convention.

description.description: One sentence describing the observable behavior this test verifies.

type.description: Test type: unit (in-memory, no DB), integration (requires DB), manual (slow/external), or live_dispatch (exercises production entrypoint without dispatch_fn override).

surface_invoked.description: Required when type == live_dispatch. Names the slash command, hook script, or agent entrypoint being invoked in production wiring (e.g. 'glossary_bootstrap.py' or '/glossary-bootstrap').

target_dir.description: Relative path to the test directory where the test file should live (e.g. unit_tests/live_trader/). Use 'new directory needed' if no matching directory exists in testing_context.directories.

covers.description: The specific function, class, or behavior under test.
